cmd: tc actions replace action mirred ingress mirror index 1 dev lo
desc: positive: Replace mirred redirect to block action with mirror to dev
pre: ip link add v0p1 type veth peer name v0p0 && ip link set v0p1 up && ip link set v0p0 up
tc actions add action mirred help 2>&1 | grep -q blockid
tc qdisc add dev v0p1 ingress_block 21 clsact
tc actions add action mirred egress redirect index 1 blockid 21

readback.cmd: tc -j actions get action mirred index 1
readback.name: verify
